objective: Drive qualified project enquiries (email or phone) for NEZAAD Industries from small-business owners in Telangana
audience: Owners of small businesses and shops in Khammam and wider Telangana who have a slow site, an outdated one, or none, and who reach the web mostly on mid-range Android phones
offer: A website written by hand — semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JavaScript — with Core Web Vitals budgets agreed before the build starts, source code handed over, and hosting billed to the client at cost

approved_claims.claim: Websites are hand-written in semantic HTML, modern CSS and vanilla JavaScript, with no framework by default
Core Web Vitals budgets for LCP, CLS and INP are agreed before the build starts
WCAG 2.2 AA, full keyboard support and screen-reader checks are part of the build
The client receives the source code and deploy steps at handover
Hosting and domain are registered in the client's name and billed to them directly by the provider
Up to three revision rounds are included on every project
No prices are published, and scope changes are quoted and approved before the work happens

hypotheses.insight: A visitor on a mid-range Android phone abandons a slow page before it renders; the owner never sees the loss because it does not show up as a complaint.
hypotheses.promise: A site that appears on a cheap phone on a patchy connection, because the weight was budgeted before the first line of code.
hypotheses.hook: "Your website is slow. Your customers don't tell you — they leave."
hypotheses.experiment_hypothesis: A loss-framed speed hook beats a capability statement on qualified-enquiry rate for the same budget and the same landing page.

hypotheses.insight: Small-business owners have been burned by a site they cannot edit and cannot leave; lock-in is the real objection behind "I'll think about it".
hypotheses.promise: You get the repository, the deploy steps and a walkthrough. Hosting is in your name, billed at cost, no markup.
hypotheses.hook: "Can you edit your own website, or do you have to call someone?"
hypotheses.experiment_hypothesis: An ownership/exiting framing produces fewer but better-qualified enquiries than a speed framing, measurable as enquiry-to-reply rate.

hypotheses.insight: Everyone in this market promises everything. Stating what you will not do is the cheapest way to be believed.
hypotheses.promise: No templates sold as custom work. No framework unless the problem needs one. No invoice for work that was not agreed in writing first.
hypotheses.hook: "Four things this developer will refuse to do."
hypotheses.experiment_hypothesis: A negative/limits-first creative earns a higher click-through and a lower bounce than a benefit-first creative, because the destination page states the same limits.
